context_for_next_testing_agent: Reown WalletConnect allowlist fix for https://checkout.dynopay.com is confirmed live. Relay accepts the origin (result:true, no code:3000), Pulse returns 202, pairing URI (wc:...) is generated on both desktop QR view and mobile Open/Copy-link view. Project ID in use: f83ed4e19b1bf8e6b381f6485b191ae1. Use route mocks in /app/memory/test_credentials.md when re-testing this flow on production.
rca of the issue: Reown project's Verify/allowlist did not include https://checkout.dynopay.com (only dynopay.com + safedeal.sh). The relay handshake was rejected with {code:3000, 'Unauthorized: origin not allowed'} so no pairing URI was generated, causing QR to be blank on desktop and the mobile 'Open' button never to appear. Fix: adding checkout.dynopay.com to the Reown dashboard allowlist. Verification (this run): relay now returns result:true, pulse 202, wc: URI present, mobile 'Open Binance Wallet' button rendered.
